description:
After "Emilie" stole $812,000 from a widower in the U.S., reporters traced the fake persona to a scam compound in Myanmar: "There was a five-step plan for how to manipulate people psychologically."

Watch an excerpt from @frontline & @AssociatedPress' documentary, "Scammed," an investigation of how the global online scam industry steals billions of dollars from millions of people each year.

The full documentary premieres Tues., Sept. 29, 2026, on PBS and online. Learn more: https://to.pbs.org/4hkJety

This journalism is made possible by viewers like you. Donate to FRONTLINE now: https://bit.ly/47DFzCb

And support your local PBS station here: https://www.pbs.org/donate

“Scammed” is a FRONTLINE Production with Peter Klein Productions in association with The Associated Press. The writer, producer and director is Peter Klein. The co-producers are Megan Robinson and Boris Ivanov. The reporters are Erika Kinetz, Juliet Linderman and Martha Mendoza. The senior producers are Frank Koughan
title: Searching for 'Emilie' — and Uncovering a Romance Scam Playbook | FRONTLINE + @Associated Press
